$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. LoopActivationReceipt is one instance of the general Receipt-envelope-with-a-receiptType-enum concept named at docs/ratified/loops/LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §10 and 10_DUAL_VALIDATION_ADDENDUM.md §E — that full consolidation (one Receipt<T> wrapper for every receipt kind in the constellation) is WP-2 scope, NOT designed here; `receiptType` below is this document's forward-compatible seam for that future union, fixed to the single literal value this domain owns today. Required-field content is FB-RAT-IMP-009 verbatim ('every installation records source, package digest, signature state, validation report, bindings digest, authority grant IDs, and installation receipt'), specializing the FB-RAT-COM-008 provenance minimum the same way schemas/integrations/import-receipt.v1.schema.json specializes it for the DATA_IMPORT profile — cross-referenced, not re-derived.
title: LoopActivationReceipt
description: The durable, append-only record written on entry to InstallationState.INSTALLED (docs/ratified/loops/LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §3, §10). A correction is a NEW receipt with a fresh receiptId, never an in-place edit of an existing one (FB-RAT-COM-006).

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of this receipt shape. A reader MUST reject an unrecognized MAJOR (FB-RAT-COM-003).

receiptId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this receipt (FB-RAT-COM-002); also the idempotency anchor for a retried install-confirmation tap (FB-RAT-COM-006).

receiptType.description: Fixed literal discriminant this domain's receipts carry. Forward-compatible with a future consolidated Receipt<T> envelope keyed on this same field (10_DUAL_VALIDATION_ADDENDUM.md §E, WP-2 scope) — not itself that envelope.

installationId.description: Back-reference to the loop-installation.schema.json LoopInstallation.installationId this receipt closes out (FB-RAT-COM-002).

loopId.description: Stable human/version identity of the loop family (LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §2), independent of packageDigest.

packageDigest.description: packageContentDigest of the exact bytes installed (floop-container-format.v1.json) — FB-RAT-IMP-009 'package digest'.

source.description: FB-RAT-IMP-009 'source' — the transfer envelope this installation began from. Null only for a receipt reconstructed from a pre-this-convention record; a live producer MUST populate it.

signatureState.description: FB-RAT-IMP-009 'signature state' — LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §11's terminal signature posture at install time. A receipt (only ever written on reaching INSTALLED) MUST carry one of the four IMPORTED_* values — see the allOf below.

compatibilityOutcome.description: The overall outcome LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §3 (FB-RAT-CMP-004) resolved to for this activation. Only COMPATIBLE, COMPATIBLE_WITH_BINDINGS, or DEGRADED are reachable in a real receipt — BLOCKED/UNSUPPORTED route to the BLOCKED_INCOMPATIBLE terminal state (LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §3) and never produce this receipt at all; the full five-value enum is reused here rather than narrowed, so this schema does not drift from LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md's own enum.

validationRulesetVersion.description: The loop-validation-rules.v1.json rulesetVersion applied (FB-RAT-IMP-009 'validation report... rulesetVersion applied').

validationFindings.description: FB-RAT-IMP-009 'validation report... findings' — the findings the PARSED_VALIDATED transition's full loop-validation-report.schema.json document carried, summarized inline here. This array is a copy for receipt self-containment, not a substitute for the full report (installationRef points at it).

boundSlots.description: One entry per binding slot resolved for this activation (LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §5) — the human-readable summary FB-RAT-CMP-003 requires be recorded ('substitutions are recorded in the activation receipt').

bindingProfileDigest.description: FB-RAT-IMP-009 'bindings digest' — digest of the binding-profile.schema.json document `boundSlots` above summarizes. Null only when no slots required binding (an empty `boundSlots` array).

grantedAuthoritySummary.description: Authority actually granted, grouped by rung (LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §6's Observe/Read/Propose/Write/External/Destructive/Publish review buckets, mapped onto CAPABILITY_AUTHORITY_MODEL.md's eight-rung ladder) — human-readable summary form.

authorityGrantIds.description: FB-RAT-IMP-009 'authority grant IDs' — the exact Grant.grantId values (schemas/authority/grant.schema.json) issued during WAITING_AUTHORITY, machine-resolvable form of `grantedAuthoritySummary` above.

simulationResult.description: FB-RAT-PHN-009 dangerous-first-run-simulation outcome (LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §7). Null only when this activation's authority request never crossed the Write/External/Destructive/Publish threshold that makes simulation mandatory.

installedAtUtc.description: FB-RAT-COM-004: UTC instant of the INSTALLABLE-to-INSTALLED transition this receipt records.

engineVersion.description: capability-ids.v1.json's engineVersion — the installing phone's loop contract/engine surface version at install time, decoupled from the app's own release version (`producer.version` below, when present).

producer.description: The app instance that produced this receipt — `producer.version` is the Fonebrew app's own release version, kept independent of `engineVersion` above per capability-ids.v1.json's engineVersion definition.

warnings.description: FB-RAT-IMP-009 'any warnings the user acknowledged' — e.g. an unsigned-package warning or a simulation-gap acknowledgement, in the user's own confirmed language, not raw error codes.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

allOf.$comment: This receipt exists only because InstallationState reached INSTALLED, so signatureState MUST already have settled to one of the four IMPORTED_* terminal postures (LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §11), never a transient state like SIGNATURE_PRESENT.

PackageSignatureState.description: Copied verbatim from LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §11's state table — duplicated here rather than $ref'd from loop-installation.schema.json, per this corpus's standalone-schema convention.

CompatibilityOutcome.description: LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §3's five-value outcome enum (FB-RAT-CMP-004), duplicated here rather than $ref'd from loop-compatibility-report.schema.json.

code.description: A rule code from loop-validation-rules.v1.json. Membership in that frozen registry is validated by the rule engine, not this schema — see the sibling adversarial fixture for an unregistered-but-shape-valid code.

selectedProviderId.description: The resolved provider/resource ID this slot was bound to (LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §5 'selected provider/resource ID').

substitutionReason.description: Required in practice whenever substitutionPolicy is not EXACT_ONLY (FB-RAT-CMP-003 'substitutions are recorded... which declared or discovered alternative was actually chosen and why') — not enforced structurally here because a schema cannot see whether a value equals the slot's original EXACT declaration without the package's own manifest in scope.

authorityRung.description: CAPABILITY_AUTHORITY_MODEL.md's eight-rung ladder (FB-RAT-AUTH-002), duplicated from schemas/authority/grant.schema.json's $defs/AuthorityRung.

outcome.description: LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §7: a passing simulation is evidence the declared behavior is well-formed against its own fixtures, never a claim the live target will succeed.

gapAcknowledgedByUser.description: Required true when outcome is SKIPPED_NO_SIMULATOR_AVAILABLE (§7: 'the UI MUST state the gap explicitly and require a stronger, distinct acknowledgement') — not enforced structurally here; see the adversarial fixture for the schema-valid-but-rule-violating case.
